title: Determine Winning Islands in Race
statement: Two cows race across n islands joined by one-way main bridges from each island to the next, plus m extra one-way bridges only the second cow may use. Islands collapse behind a departing cow, eliminating anyone stranded. The first cow starts on island s and moves first; with n and m up to 2*10^5, determine for every start s whether she reaches island n first under optimal play.
